levels.surface: محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: «وبهذا الاسناد» takes over the previous chain up to the name the text repeats (إبراهيم بن الحكم), so the first three levels are inherited from prev1
Hudhayfa is the speaker of the Prophet's words («فقال: سمعت رسول الله») and so the last link (rule 6); the Prophet is not a link
«يا أبا عبد الله» is a vocative to Hudhayfa, not a link; «(1)» and «(رضي الله عنه)» are glosses

fixes.reason: The text has Hudhayfa speak the Prophet's words after Bilal's account; RWY stops at Bilal.
